mode: read-only extraction + on-board run under /data/local/tmp/bionic43 only; no /system write, no remount, no reflash; board 5cd1e3dd shared with #42 by process mutex (pidof com.ss.android.article.news checked empty before each run); test exits, not resident
goal: Run a Java hello on official AOSP14 arm64 ART (dalvikvm64 + libart + boot image + BCP) brought up by the #39 Bionic linker64/libc, with the boot image loaded (not interpreted).

avc.method: dmesg direct grep from a /dev/kmsg marker (not line count); run domain u:r:su:s0 (dalvikvm64 launched from the su shell per the task)

provenance.source_image: arm64-v8a-34_r04.zip (official Google AOSP14 arm64, build UE1A.230829.036.A1, API 34; #39 download, zip sha1 d9f2011131919abe952814e041f16f317242c3fa)
provenance.art: com.android.art.capex -> original_apex -> apex_payload.img (dalvikvm64, libart + 20 ART libs, javalib jars)
provenance.boot_image: /system/framework/arm64/boot*.{art,oat} (real) + /system/framework/boot*.vdex (real; the arm64/*.vdex are symlinks to these)

layout_on_board.lib64: 45 shared libs (21 ART apex, 12 system/lib64, 5 runtime-bionic, 5 i18n, 2 special) + lib64/bionic/{libc,libdl,libm}.so
layout_on_board.system/etc/public.libraries.txt: emptied (Java hello needs no NDK public libs)
layout_on_board.ld.config.txt: minimal linker config selected via LD_CONFIG_FILE

invocation.launcher: linker64 (executable mode, absolute path) -> dalvikvm64  (dalvikvm64's baked PT_INTERP /system/bin/linker64 would hit the OH musl linker)

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: dlopen failed: library libartpalette-system.so not found
blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: ART palette system impl is dlopen'd at runtime (not DT_NEEDED); lives in /system/lib64

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: Error reading public native library list .../system/etc/public.libraries.txt: No such file
blockers_hit_and_solved.fix: provide it (emptied — no NDK libs needed for hello)

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: Failed to get system namespace for loading libandroid.so
blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: no /linkerconfig/ld.config.txt -> linker only has the default namespace; nativeloader wants named namespaces
blockers_hit_and_solved.fix: author a minimal ld.config.txt and select it with LD_CONFIG_FILE (/linkerconfig absent on OH, / is read-only)

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: Error preloading public library libandroid.so: not found

blockers_hit_and_solved.fix: add com_android_art + com_android_i18n namespaces to ld.config.txt

blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: ART LOG/abort go to logd which is absent on OH (the same broken native-log channel #44 tracks); messages dropped
blockers_hit_and_solved.fix: -Xuse-stderr-logger routes ART logging to stderr — the visible native-log channel for ART
blockers_hit_and_solved.note: directly answers the outer-loop concern about native-log visibility

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: LoadNativeLibrary failed for libicu_jni.so: not found
blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: InitNativeMethods loads the ICU JNI bridge
blockers_hit_and_solved.fix: stage libicu_jni/libandroidicu/libicu from the i18n apex

blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: -Ximage must point at framework/boot.art; ART inserts the /arm64/ isa dir itself

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: Failed to mmap boot.vdex: Empty MemMap requested
blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: the vdex files under framework/arm64/ are symlinks to ../boot-*.vdex; debugfs dump captured the symlink text, not the real vdex

blockers_hit_and_solved.error: JIT could not load libart-compiler.so: not found -> Failed to allocate JIT -> abort
blockers_hit_and_solved.cause: libart-compiler.so is dlopen'd for JIT (not DT_NEEDED)

verdicts.item: AOSP14 arm64 ART VM starts on real Bionic (linker64+libc) on stock OH 6.1

notes_for_next_milestone: This ran in the su shell (u:r:su:s0). Running ART under the app domain (u:r:normal_hap:s0) is the #41 path: fork+setcon+dlopen in the private namespace, where the same libs load from appdat (proven in #41).
The JIT loaded libart-compiler.so successfully here (real Bionic); memfd-RX is denied under normal_hap (#41) so an app-domain ART would need the anon-RWX JIT fallback that ART already uses on OH.
public.libraries.txt was emptied; a real app (Toutiao) needs the NDK public libs (libandroid/libGLES/etc.) which are the 10 OH-facing shims from #39/#41 — that is the M3+ work.
libmetasec_ml's MSTaskManager::DoLazyInit visibility (the #41 open question, #44) will be observable once ART runs with -Xuse-stderr-logger or the #44 hilog fix.
